schemaStatusNote: The wire schema, protocol fields, binding/fencing rules, error semantics and fixture set are frozen at v1: native (A2) may implement against them now. What is still pending is the engine side, not the contract.

engineValidation.reason: Golden outputs under contract/expected/ are produced by the built engine (host arm64 and riscv64) in this same lane; until then the fixtures are schema-validated inputs, not engine-observed results.

engine.abi: static ELF, no dynamic loader dependency

transport.direction: native producer -> task-owned file bridge -> engine -> result file
transport.evaluate: none; the engine never asks for arbitrary JavaScript
transport.cdp: none; no DevTools protocol endpoint is opened or emulated

snapshot.producer: fixed, audited native WebKit measurement in an isolated content world
snapshot.elementIdRule: document-order index + 1; open shadow trees are appended after every light-DOM element so light ids never move
snapshot.hitTestKey: exact IEEE-754 double bits of (x, y); decimal text must round-trip

verbs.name: snapshot-schema
verbs.purpose: print the producer-facing capture contract (property columns, limits, shapes)

verbs.name: snapshot-scan
verbs.purpose: run the rule pass over a snapshot and answer needs from supplied facts
args: --timeout-ms <n> (default 120000; cancellation leaves an explicit failed result)
--strict-schema (reject unknown snapshot fields; default on for v1)

exit.3: incomplete: needs facts (never a clean result)
exit.4: ran but coverage incomplete: verdict inconclusive
exit.1: usage error, invalid input, identity mismatch, budget exceeded or cancelled

verbs.name: detect
verbs.exit: upstream semantics: 0 clean, 2 findings, 1 operational failure

excludedUpstreamPaths.reason: installation and updates are Hub-owned and digest-bound; the engine never downloads
no upstream telemetry endpoint from a Floe guest
network or local-server verbs outside v1
live rewrite server and editor hooks are not part of the Floe v1 flow
Chromium/CDP capture; forbidden by the integration contract
no Chromium dependency for a native page scan

needs.semantics: Needs is a real answer, not an error and never a clean scan. Points must be answered on the same document identity, then the scan re-run.

floeExtensions.captureId: must equal the identity the needs were issued for
floeExtensions.documentId: must equal the snapshot's document identity

rules: top is the snapshot element id of document.elementFromPoint(x, y), 0 when nothing
stack is document.elementsFromPoint(x, y) mapped to snapshot ids, front to back, zeros dropped
an unanswerable point must be reported as top 0 with an empty stack, and the run then reports it as unanswered rather than clean
facts for a superseded captureId/documentId are rejected

shape.taskId: string, the Floe task/conversation that owns this capture
shape.documentId: string, stable for the document the snapshot measured
shape.documentGeneration: integer, monotonic per tab; bumps on navigation, reload or a document swap
shape.url: string, the document URL at capture

producer.name: string
producer.scriptDigest: sha256 of the exact fixed measurement script bytes

bindingRules: the snapshot, every needs document and every facts document carry the same taskId/sessionId/tabId/documentId/captureId
hostname, viewport and scroll in the identity must equal the snapshot's own values
a facts file whose binding differs from the loaded snapshot is rejected, not merged
fencing: navigation, reload, a documentGeneration bump, a viewport change or a scroll change invalidates the snapshot and every needs/facts pair issued for it
the native side fences the capture at the moment of navigation or view change; a late answer for a fenced capture must be refused
the engine reports identityCheck.state as verified | absent | mismatch | superseded and never treats a mismatch as a scan result
privacy: the producer is a fixed, audited native script; no arbitrary or model-authored JavaScript and no model-declared trust
producer.scriptDigest binds the exact script bytes that ran
password input values, form control values and credential-bearing attributes are redacted before the snapshot leaves the device
a snapshot whose identity does not claim an applied redaction policy is rejected in strict mode

budgets.onExceeded: fail closed: status failed, explicit reason, no findings presented as a scan result

cleanVerdictRequires: needs empty (no hit tests, no scroll probes)
every pass with requiredForCleanVerdict == true is covered/complete
no budget exceeded and no cancellation

coveragePasses.title: elementFromPoint/elementsFromPoint answers for rule-decided points
coveragePasses.notes: Answered by the native producer on the same document identity; exact f64 bits must round-trip.

coveragePasses.title: Computed-style property parity (unknown_style_props)
coveragePasses.notes: A property the rules read but the capture did not record makes the run partial, never clean.

coveragePasses.title: shown_when_scrolled_to answers (content hidden at rest)
coveragePasses.notes: Unanswered probes count as hidden upstream; Floe reports them as unanswered instead of clean.

coveragePasses.title: Static markup/source scan (impeccable-html + impeccable-detect)
coveragePasses.notes: Separate verb; a snapshot scan never claims it ran.

coveragePasses.title: Pixel-sampled contrast and routed low-contrast verdicts
coveragePasses.reason: Needs loadImage/readPixel or the PNG two-shot diff of the upstream URL engine; the v1 native capture has no pixel source.

coveragePasses.title: Two-shot screenshot hiding/diff evidence
coveragePasses.reason: URL-engine evidence pass; not part of the snapshot contract.

coveragePasses.title: Pre-capture scroll/reveal sweep and overlay settling
coveragePasses.reason: Content revealed only by scrolling is not measured; reveal-on-scroll findings cannot be produced or excluded.

coveragePasses.title: Hidden-text measurement with scroll probes (URL engine step)
coveragePasses.reason: The URL engine's hidden-text step is not ported; scroll-probe needs are surfaced but never answered by Floe v1.

coveragePasses.title: Consent banner / page overlay hiding before capture
coveragePasses.reason: Requires live page mutation; Floe keeps the page untouched.

coveragePasses.title: Console/script error capture
coveragePasses.reason: Needs a console channel; not part of the fixed measurement contract.

coveragePasses.title: Cross-origin frame content
coveragePasses.reason: SnapshotDom carries no frame content and WebKit isolation forbids cross-origin reads.

coveragePasses.title: Same-origin frame content
coveragePasses.reason: The upstream capture producer never traverses iframes; rules inside frames are lost, not passed.

coveragePasses.title: Image/video natural size and load state
coveragePasses.notes: Carried per element as `md`; visual verdicts still need the uncovered pixel pass.

coveragePasses.title: Per-line rendered text rects
coveragePasses.notes: Without `textLines` the line-level rules stand down; that is a coverage loss, not a pass.

coveragePasses.title: @keyframes rules and readable linked stylesheet corpus
